Rivian Automotive | Senior AI infra, Machine Learning Egineer | Full - Time | Hybrid | London | - https://careers.rivian.com/careers-home/jobs/24737?lang=en-u...

The ultimate goal of Rivian's new AI Hub in London is to accelerate the development of our Autonomy Platform to achieve higher levels of autonomous capability, making our vehicles safer, more technologically advanced, and "time-restoring" for our users.

About us in general: We’re a US-based EV company building groundbreaking electric trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles — and an integrated ecosystem of hardware, software, and services in order to keep the world adventurous forever.

You can also find more open roles here: https://careers.rivian.com/careers-home/jobs?sortBy=relevanc...
